description: Executes a confidential zero-knowledge state transition on Midnight Blockchain. Confidential parameters are automatically canonicalized (RFC 8785) and hashed in client RAM—never exposed on-chain or in model logs.

agentId.description: Optional Sovereign Agent DID. Defaults to the local signer's DID and must match it when provided.

confidentialPayload.description: Optional confidential parameters, canonicalized and hashed locally.
